hints.title: Kolakoski Self-Generating Property
hints.text: The string encodes its own run-length sequences. The digit at index i indicates how many times the next alternating character must be repeated.

hints.title: Dual Pointer Read-Write Simulation
hints.text: Maintain a read index head and a write index tail. Look at s[head] to append s[head] copies of alternating character 3 minus s[-1].

hints.title: Prefix Ones Counter
hints.text: Start with base seed [1, 2, 2] with head pointer at index 2. Generate characters until length n is reached, then count occurrences of 1 in s[:n].

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: String concatenation at each step generates unnecessary intermediate objects; array buffer avoids copying.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating the self-generating sequence up to length N requires O(N) time and O(N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should accurately alternate between 1 and 2 using 3 - val or bit toggle.
